barrier.rule: target evaluation proceeds only when every planned Student carries a resolved scientific status (COMPLETE) or a resolved scientific outcome (ALGORITHMIC); UNCLASSIFIED_HARD_STOP, INVALIDITY and unresolved INFRASTRUCTURE refuse

endpoints.context: C_k = (ContextNMSE_k,63 + ContextNMSE_k,127)/2; C_P = mean_k C_k (equal-query mean ContextNMSE; NOT ID1's pooled-ratio definition)
